summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.39/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.39 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 23, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 26¢ lower than a week ago, 95¢ lower than a month ago, and 62¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.02) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.73).
